analyst.summary: Rallis India's headline profit growth of over 30% this quarter looks impressive, but a meaningful part of it came from a one-time reversal of employee-cost provisions and a land-sale gain, not from the core agrochemicals business. Underlying returns on equity remain unremarkable, and the Indian crop-protection industry continues to face pricing pressure from lower-cost Chinese competitors. We would not read this quarter's headline as a genuine turnaround signal.
